Due to a permanent no-fly zone, a direct flight corridor between Tower Alpha and Tower Beta is unavailable. Furthermore, due to overlapping frequency bands that cause interference, the routing protocol must incorporate exactly one of the following two critical links: the link between Tower Beta and Tower Gamma, or the link between Tower Gamma and Tower Delta.

The objective is to determine the minimal total flight distance for a single drone to complete a closed-circuit inspection, visiting every tower precisely once before returning to its origin.
